dayPrompts.daily-reading-v2:
Use case: illustration-story.
Asset type: original editorial watercolor-and-graphite illustration for Santa Biblia website cards and minihero.
Input images 1 and 2 are STYLE REFERENCES ONLY. Match their sophisticated adult hand-drawn graphite outlines, richly detailed translucent watercolor pigment, warm ivory paper grain, feathered painted perimeter and calm intimate presence. Create a new scene.
Palette: muted petrol blue and restrained turquoise, natural olive, reddish sand, dusty rose; balanced warm daylight with no yellow or mustard cast. Colors have presence, not washed out. Finely drawn details, calm sobriety, natural material texture. No photo, 3D, flat cartoon, text, lettering, border or watermark.
Composition: landscape 1536x1024. Fill the frame with the scene, very little blank paper. Important subject occupies central-right region and remains intact within the central horizontal panoramic band (a 3:1 crop of this image). Left third contains softly suggested background detail to support overlaid page text. Keep hero subjects at midheight and avoid important content at extreme top and bottom.
Primary scene: a beautiful open Bible resting on a simple worn wooden table beside an open Mediterranean stone window, one small olive branch laid near the pages. The open book centered-right is the strong focal subject; window reveals distant soft hills and morning light. View at a shallow three-quarter angle, open Bible modest in size so the book and its entire spread fit within the middle half of image height. Detailed natural pencil marks suggest typeset lines without readable words. Table grain and stone texture, quiet warmth without golden-yellow haze.
